bullets.title: SNDK Investor Day: 80% Gross Margins, $93.9B Contract Value, Flash Market to $500B by 2027
bullets.body: SanDisk CEO guided mid-to-high teens revenue growth through FY2030, targeting ~80% non-GAAP gross margins and 50% adj FCF margins. Notably, the company expects to collect $93.9B in total contract value from 8 customers over contract lives. One analyst flagged that SNDK is 'sandbagging' projections via conservative NVM RPO calculation methodology, suggesting more upside than guided. Flash memory market projected to grow from $300B (2026) to nearly $500B (2027).

bullets.title: SanDisk Tapes Out First High-Bandwidth Flash Die; Meta Joins Open Standard Consortium
bullets.body: SanDisk exec confirmed tape-out of the first high-bandwidth flash (HBF) memory die targeting inference applications. Meta is joining a SanDisk-led consortium to develop an open standard for high-bandwidth flash—a meaningful ecosystem development that could accelerate HBF adoption across hyperscalers including GOOGL and NVDA.

bullets.title: MU $707 Flagged as the Low; HBM/DRAM Framed as Non-Commodity Premium Business
bullets.body: A fintwit analyst argues MU at $707 marked the cycle bottom, characterizing HBM, DRAM, and SNDK NAND as 'non-commodity' high-margin data center products rather than generic memory. Separately, a $2.7M call order on MU at a $2,000 strike (109% OTM) was flagged as unusual; NVDA/AMD/MU calls also reportedly 'doubled' after whale positioning earlier in the week preceded a semiconductor sector rally.

bullets.title: AMD Plans $5B Debt Sale for AI Expansion; Unusual Far-OTM INTC Calls Hit Tape
bullets.body: AMD is raising up to $5B in a four-part bond deal (potentially largest ever) to fund AI infrastructure expansion following major deals with Anthropic and Microsoft. Separately, millions of dollars in far out-of-the-money INTC calls hit the tape, flagged as unusual positioning; multi-desk attention noted on Intel hinting at potential memory reentry alongside CEO purchasing $12-13M in shares.

bullets.title: INTC Analyst Consensus Flipped: 9 Buys in 2023 vs 19 Buys in 2026; Outperforming NVDA
bullets.body: A widely-shared chart shows INTC analyst sentiment reversed dramatically—from 9 buys/23 holds/12 sells in 2023 at $25 to 19 buys/33 holds/2 sells in 2026 near $106 consensus PT. Intel reportedly outperforming NVDA since early 2024. UBS also flagged potential AMD foundry deal with Intel amid AMD's underdog status in data center rack markets.

bullets.title: NVDA Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics in Full Production; Rubin Ultra Uses HBM4E Not HBM4
bullets.body: NVIDIA's Spectrum-X Ethernet photonics entered full production for gigawatt-scale AI factory networking. Separately, Aletheia research reveals Rubin Ultra will use 8-high/12-high HBM4E (not HBM4 as assumed), and the four-die Rubin Ultra configuration remains on roadmap for Kyber—Kyber has not been canceled.

bullets.title: CoreWeave/NVDA A100 Contracts Extended to 2029; AI Infrastructure 'Supercycle' Confirmed
bullets.body: CoreWeave is renting NVIDIA's 6-year-old A100 GPUs through 2029, extending Ampere's lifespan to nine years—defying typical deprecation. CoreWeave and Nebius earnings were cited as underlining the AI infrastructure supercycle. NVIDIA also published an 'AI Tokenomics Guide' framing compute-to-revenue conversion; early NVIDIA chip contracts reportedly extend to 2029.

bullets.title: CSCO Stock Drops >10% After Earnings Miss; AI Spending Signals Mixed at Enterprise Layer
bullets.body: Cisco and Cerebras both dropped over 10% in this session, per a daily semiconductor recap. CoreWeave/Nebius earnings highlight AI infrastructure supercycle while Cisco/Lenovo suggest AI spending is reaching enterprise hardware—but with execution gaps. YMTC also gained third place in NAND, adding competitive pressure.

bullets.title: CIEN, NOK Bullish Thesis: AI Campus Scale Expansion Supported by LITE and COHR Commentary
bullets.body: A fintwit analyst argues CIEN and NOK stand to benefit from expanding AI campus footprints spanning multiple geographies, citing bullish scale commentary from LITE and COHR earnings calls. COHR Q4 call separately confirmed transceiver assembly is not the primary supply chain bottleneck.

bullets.title: LITE Earnings Call: Scale Across Strategy Highlighted; CIEN and CSCO Named as Competitors
bullets.body: One of the more notable elements of LITE's latest earnings call was discussion of the 'Scale Across' strategy. Competitors CIEN (coherent DSP/NPO/CPO/FST) and CSCO/Acacia (coherent pluggables, 800G DSP, coherent transmission) were named as active in overlapping segments.

bullets.title: 30-Year Treasury Auction Clears at 5.216%, Highest Yield Since 2001; 0.4bp Tail
bullets.body: The 30Y bond auction drew a high yield of 5.216% with a 0.4bps tail, the highest yield since 2001. Bid-to-cover was 2.39x; indirect bidders took 66.8%, primary dealers 11.5%, directs 21.6%. Multiple fintwit accounts flagged this as signaling elevated borrowing costs and potential demand weakness.

bullets.title: PPI Misses Across the Board; Rate-Hike Odds Plummet, VIX Below 15
bullets.body: July PPI came in flat M/M (0.0% vs +0.2% est) and +4.7% Y/Y (vs +4.9% est); core PPI +0.2% M/M vs +0.3% est. Following the miss, market expectations for Fed rate hikes in 2026 dropped sharply. VIX fell below 15 to 2026 lows. BofA economists still forecast 3 Fed rate increases in 2026 while CreditSights sees rates unchanged through H1 2027.

bullets.title: S&P 500 Hits New All-Time Highs at 7,800; Equal-Weight RSP Also at ATH
bullets.body: S&P 500 crossed above 7,800 for the first time, its 9th 100-point milestone of the year; index was at 6,400 one year ago and 4,400 five years ago. Equal-weight RSP also reached all-time highs, signaling broad market participation rather than just mega-cap leadership. SPY call walls at $775 ($5B+) and $780 ($6B) noted as significant options exposure.

bullets.title: Tech Guidance Raises at 2.3x Historical Average; One-Third of Reporters Raised Guidance
bullets.body: Nearly one-third of tech stocks that reported Q2 earnings raised guidance this season, running at 2.3x the 25-year historical average of 14%. Health Care, Real Estate, and Industrials are also raising guidance at approximately double historical rates—broad earnings cycle strength.

bullets.title: Diesel Crack Spread Hits All-Time High Above $98 on Houthi Attack on Saudi Aramco Refinery
bullets.body: Yemen's Houthis reportedly struck Saudi Aramco's Jizan Refinery, sending diesel crack spreads to an all-time high above $98/barrel. Brent crude futures fell ~$1 in net on profit-taking after a 5-session rally, with WTI below $82. Hormuz commercial traffic remains 'single digits' in both directions per UKMTO.

bullets.title: Anthropic Valued at $2-3T; $100-120B ARR Expected by Year-End; CRO Departs
bullets.body: Anthropic backers are reportedly projecting a $2-3T valuation ahead of a potential October IPO that could be the largest market debut ever. Backers expect $100-120B annualized revenue by year-end. However, CRO Denise Dresser departed after less than a year; Dali Rajic named as replacement CRO, signaling potential revenue execution uncertainty.

bullets.title: Google Launches Gemini 3.7 Flash for Coding and Agents; DeepSeek Raises Prices 4x
bullets.body: Google released Gemini 3.7 Flash, described as its 'most intelligent workhorse model' for coding and agents. Simultaneously, DeepSeek raised AI model prices more than 4x effective August 16 (V4-Flash from $0.28 to $1.32 per million output tokens), moving closer to competitor pricing—reduces the deflationary pricing pressure narrative from DeepSeek.

bullets.title: Bill Ackman Adds Netflix, UBER, MSFT, META, AMZN in Largest Portfolio Revamp in Years
bullets.body: Pershing Square disclosed six new positions including Netflix, Visa, Mastercard, UBER, MSFT, META, and AMZN in Q2. Ackman repurchased NFLX after a prior 2022 exit, viewing the company as dominant in its category. Pershing Square was reportedly down 3.5% YTD through July vs. S&P 500's 13% gain.

bullets.title: IREN Delivers Horizon 1 to Microsoft; Achieves NVIDIA GB300 Exemplar Cloud Status
bullets.body: IREN announced delivery of its Horizon 1 product to Microsoft and confirmed achievement of NVIDIA Exemplar Cloud status on the GB300 platform—a certification that validates AI infrastructure readiness at the highest tier.

bullets.title: SMCI: $65-72B FY27 Revenue Guidance vs $25B Market Cap; Analyst Flags GPU Smuggling Scandal
bullets.body: Analyst notes SMCI guided $65-72B revenue for FY2027 while the stock trades at only ~$25B market cap, suggesting either a credibility discount or valuation opportunity. The same analyst flagged SMCI's alleged attempt to smuggle NVDA GPUs using hairdryers as a key overhang distinguishing it from a DELL-like trajectory.
